mapper.insert: insert into experience_like (post_id, user_id, create_time) values (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{createTime})
insert into experience_like (comment_id, user_id, create_time) values (#{commentId}, #{userId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select u.id as userId, u.name as userName, u.avatar as userAvatar, u.follower_count as followerCount, u.following_count as followingCount, u.liked_count as likedCount, u.post_count as postCount from experience_like el left join user u on el.user_id = u.id where el.post_id = #{postId} order by el.create_time desc
